current_grouping: Subpart H – Command and Control Data Link

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart H – Command and Control data link
versions.text: See AMC.1601 (a) The UAV System communication system consists of the following subsystems: (1) the command and control data link subsystem, (2) the ATC communication subsystem, (3) the payload data link subsystem. The present subpart H only covers the command and control data link subsystem. ATC communication and payload data link are regulated by Operation materials. (b) A UAV System must include a command and control data link (a radio-frequency link, for example) for control of the UAV with the following functions: (1) Transmittal of UAV crew commands from the UCS to the UAV (uplink), and (2) Transmittal of UAV status data from the UAV to the UCS (downlink). This status data must include, to the appropriate extent, navigational information, response to UAV crew commands, and equipment operating parameters in accordance with subpart I requirements.

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart H – Command and Control Data Link
versions.text: See AMC.U1601 (a) The UAS communication system typically consists of the following subsystems: (1) the command and control data link subsystem, (2) the ATC communication subsystem, (3) the payload data link subsystem. The present subpart H only covers the command and control data link subsystem. ATC communication and payload data link are covered by Operating Regulations and Standards. (b) A UAS must include a command and control data link (a radio-frequency link, for example) for control of the UAS with the following functions: (1) Transmittal of UAS crew commands from the UCS to the UA (uplink), and (2) Transmittal of UAS status data from the UA to the UCS (downlink). This status data must include, to the appropriate extent, navigational information, response to UAS crew commands, and equipment operating parameters in accordance with subpart I requirements.
